hypothesis: Token-block boundaries may explain steady-state variation better than text length. Complementary indicators preserve separation of the two exceptional states while testing sensitivity to how the fitted model allocates baseline costs.

pcvs.name: prompt_tokens
pcvs.rationale: Captures work proportional to prompt token count.

pcvs.name: complete_token_blocks
pcvs.rationale: Tests whether block-based hashing and cache setup explain variation better than character count.

pcvs.name: outside_ten_token_regime
pcvs.rationale: Separates the exceptional ten-token initialization state using the steady-state regime as the active indicator.

pcvs.name: outside_nine_token_regime
pcvs.rationale: Separates the elevated nine-token state using a complementary indicator.
